newsitem.title: DUBAI: Omani shares move higher in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Omani shares move higher in brisk trade.

text.p: Oman shares ended the week to Wednesday higher in busy trade buoyed by strong across-the-board buying interest, the Muscat Securities Market said.
It said the index ended 6.83 points higher at 195.53 points from 188.70 a week earlier.
Of the 61 companies traded in the week, shares of 36 rose, 10 fell, and 15 were unchanged.
A total of 4.78 million shares changed hands compared to the previous week's 2.17 million shares.
The banking and investment sector accounted for 81 percent of total trading value of 11.1 million rials ($29 million) from almost 3.98 million rials the previous week.
Among major gainer were Al-Ahlia Portfolio APC.OM which closed firmer at 3.300 rials from 3.100, and Oman Flour Mills which ended higher at 4.000 rials from 3.830.
